# Mapped-value merge carriers

Independently authored Java8 methods keep two mapping functions and an invariant
merge carrier for the second output formal. A frozen observer checks opaque
provider effects, original argument references, callback order, returned objects,
partial failures and delayed casts. Actual standard collectors exercise duplicate
keys, merge results, null removal and failures. Source and SDK profiles compile
every recovered unit and compare all original Signatures, roles, Exceptions and
reported helpers. No private application bytes or behavior form these fixtures.
